kurz: Let the dough prove overnight in the fridge. It develops more flavour, and you bake when it suits you.
bild_im_kopf: Like a braise that sits overnight: slow is flavour.
was_passiert: In the fridge the yeast works very slowly, while [[enzym|enzymes]] and bacteria keep working. More aroma compounds and sugars form, which later help the crust brown better. Cold dough is also easier to score.
schritte: Knead the dough and give it a short first prove at room temperature.
Shape it and put it in a banneton.
Score and bake straight from the fridge.
